resources.string: Other apps
Let other apps control the keyboard
Accept commands from adb, Tasker and other automation apps

When this is on, other apps on the phone can send the keyboard commands, for example to change the language or the theme. The Allowed actions screen sets which commands work. When this is off, the keyboard ignores all commands.
Allowed actions
Choose what other apps can make the keyboard do
%1$d on
Apps can send only the commands that are on
Other apps cannot control the keyboard now. These choices apply only when Let other apps control the keyboard is on.
Turn on
Keyboard controls
Each of these does the same thing as a control on the keyboard, and you can undo it. They are on by default.
Needs more trust
These change what the keyboard knows, type into apps, or tell other apps what you do. They are off by default. Turn one on only for an automation that you set up yourself.
Switch language and layout
Set, cycle and list the layouts that you turned on
Apply a keyboard mode
Choose a mode, or go back to automatic
Change the theme
Choose one of your keyboard themes
Show and pin the keyboard
Show the keyboard, and keep it on screen or stop
Sound and haptics
Turn key sound and vibration on or off

Turn each saver on or off
Size and position
Normal, one-handed, split or floating
Open a tool
Open the panel of a tool on the keyboard
Turn incognito on
Stop learning until incognito is off again
Turn incognito off
Start learning from your typing again
Add and block words
Add words to your dictionary, or stop words in suggestions
Back up now
Start a backup to the automatic backup destination
Pause and resume backups
Pause or resume the scheduled backup and sync
Announce layout changes
Tell all apps that listen when the language or layout changes
Export data
Write your dictionary, settings and more to a file in a folder you pick. Never your API keys or clipboard
Data export

Each export replaces %1$s in this folder. The file is not encrypted, so any app that can open the folder can read your words in it. Pick a folder that only the apps you trust can open. You get a notification each time.
